review.evidence: Compared the whole 2026-10-28 source with the guide. Overview: Display (large display, Sidecar), Ergonomics (stationary use; on a touch-display Mac people reach forward, so touch is for brief intentional interactions), Inputs (keyboard and pointing device primary; trackpad or touch-display gestures, Siri, Voice Control, game controllers), App interactions (minutes to hours, smooth active/inactive transitions) and System features (menu bar, file management, full screen, Dock menus) are all kept. Best practices: all seven items are kept, including the new touch item with larger tap targets, expanding controls and unchanged control size and density. The 1-3 ft viewing distance that the source removed is no longer in the guide. Resources headings are kept as metadata and the change log lists October 28, 2026. I found no omission, wrong number or wrong platform scope.

sections.evidence: Rechecked against the 2026-10-28 source: brief and deep work with many apps, Sidecar display extension, stationary desk/table use, keyboard and pointing device primary with trackpad/touch-display gestures, Siri, Voice Control and game controllers as other inputs, and touch for brief intentional actions; the removed 1-3 ft distance is no longer claimed.

Rechecked all seven items, including the new touch item (standard trackpad and touch-display gestures, larger tap targets, controls that expand on touch, unchanged size and density), plus the System features list (menu bar, file management, full screen, Dock menus) in the last bullet.
Metadata only: the guide records the single source revision date, October 28, 2026; no design rule is inferred from it.
